skills.name: 3 Strike Rush
skills.description: Sprints at opponents, and hits them 3 times. Bad effects on enemies  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (5 sec) *ATK x 3100% Area Damage  *Stuns enemies (5 sec)

skills.name: Liberation of Power
skills.description: Yujiro Hanma puts charged power into the ground. Good effects on allies  *Creates a shield over an area (4 sec) *ATK +300% (7 sec) *Resets the Skill cooldown of some allies.

abilities.name: Group: Baki Hanma
abilities.description: Baki Hanma Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Enemy Cost Increase2
abilities.description: Gives a set chance of greatly increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed.  This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
